items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Was one of the called the Eagles, and then there was Ebon Thomas. No, that's not the one. [INTERVIEWEE] That's not the one.

ctx.x: Well, I was- we were in Lake Charles at that time. I think that was in 1929. It was during the high water, we went to Lake Charles for the high water. It was in 27, I think. Oh, yes, there was a big flood in 27, I remember that. Yeah, in Iberia. Well, we was in Lake Charles, and we stayed over there. And then my mother came up there during the high water. See, I was up there a little before, living with my sister. Is your sister older than you? Yeah, she's older than me. And I quite, I used to go to dances and…
Yes. Was one of the called the Eagles, and then there was Ebon Thomas. No, that's not the one.
That's not the one. No, this was a little band in Lake Charles. He had came from, he had just came from Electric, Texas. Electric, Texas.
